title_original: Hôtel Les Deux Girafes: Djulijan de La Crouée  – Lorsque le reflet me rend mon image
excerpt_original: In a puddle, a pool of water, or the rippling surface of a harbor, Djulijan de La Crouée discovers images at L'Hôtel des Deux Girafes from March through May 2027 Cet article Hôtel Les Deux Girafes: Djulijan de La Crouée – Lorsque le reflet me rend mon image est apparu en premier…

blocks.text: The most familiar world sometimes escapes our attention simply because we look at it too quickly. In a puddle, a reflecting pool or the shifting surface of a harbour, Djulijan de La Crouée discovers images that passers-by might never suspect. A silhouette seems to rise above the ground, a façade loses its lines, a tree merges with the sky, a ship dissolves into fragments of colour.

For the past eight years, the photographer has devoted his artistic research to reflections. His approach begins with ordinary scenes, patiently observed, revealing their transformations. Water alters perspectives, dissolves outlines, blends textures and redistributes light. Although sometimes reminiscent of Impressionism, this photographic language remains firmly rooted in reality: everything that appears in the images was encountered in the real world and captured through the lens.

From Parisian streets to wooded landscapes, from anonymous silhouettes to the hulls of boats, the scenes vary in scale and atmosphere. Reflection is never merely a decorative effect: it becomes the very subject of the photograph, sometimes immediately recognisable, sometimes disconcerting.

The exhibition Lorsque le reflet me rend mon image (“When the Reflection Returns My Image”) thus invites viewers to question appearances. Where does the landscape begin, and where does its double end? What can we recognise in a figure rendered almost abstract by movement? Each photograph allows for multiple interpretations. The artist seeks neither to explain his images entirely nor to impose a particular reading: he preserves that element of the unknown that belongs to each viewer’s gaze.

Having already exhibited in several venues, notably in Bordeaux, Nantes, La Rochelle and Fontenay-le-Comte, and received coverage in regional media, Djulijan de La Crouée continues in Paris his exploration of the encounter between the everyday and the unexpected. At Hôtel Les Deux Girafes, a selection of his works invites visitors to slow down, observe and allow themselves to be surprised.
Hôtel Les Deux Girafes 23 Passage Beslay, 75011 Paris March 1: 6:00 p.m.–9:00 p.m. March 2–May 1: 11:30 a.m.–9:00 p.m. May 2: 11:30 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Photography of the artwork is prohibited.
